home_suggestion_app_description: A small interactive app, calculator, or dashboard

home_suggestion_data_description: Turn a spreadsheet or CSV into trends and recommendations
home_suggestion_data_prompt: Turn a dataset I will share (a spreadsheet, CSV, or pasted table) into a narrative analysis: key trends, anomalies, the "so what", and concrete recommendations.
home_suggestion_deck_description: Slides with progress, risks, and what needs a decision
home_suggestion_deck_prompt: Create a slide deck for my next team meeting: where things stand, what shipped, risks and blockers, and the decisions I need from the room. Ask me what the team is working on first.
home_suggestion_one_on_one_description: A doc with a snapshot, things to inspect, and one ask
home_suggestion_one_on_one_prompt: Create a document to prepare for my next 1:1 with a direct report: a current snapshot, a coaching frame, things to inspect, carryover items from last time, and one clear ask.
home_suggestion_workflow_description: Trigger an agent when a new email arrives
home_suggestion_workflow_prompt: Create an agent workflow that runs automatically when a new email arrives: read the message, decide what to do, and take action or draft a reply. Ask me which inbox to watch and what it should handle.
